controller_semantics.name: Bank Select
controller_semantics.meaning: Selects a sound bank; confirm MSB/LSB convention and value-to-A–D mapping on hardware.

controller_semantics.name: Data Entry
controller_semantics.meaning: Writes the currently selected RPN/NRPN value; parameter number must be known.

controller_semantics.name: FX1-Type
controller_semantics.meaning: TechnoX instrument definition labels this controller as FX1 type; value map is not documented here.

controller_semantics.name: FX2-Type
controller_semantics.meaning: TechnoX instrument definition labels this controller as FX2 type; value map is not documented here.

controller_semantics.name: Arp. Resolution
controller_semantics.meaning: TechnoX instrument definition labels this controller as arpeggiator resolution; value map is not documented here.

controller_semantics.name: Arp. Speed
controller_semantics.meaning: TechnoX instrument definition labels this controller as arpeggiator speed; value map is not documented here.

controller_semantics.name: FX1-Send
controller_semantics.meaning: TechnoX instrument definition labels this controller as FX1 send.

controller_semantics.name: FX2-Send
controller_semantics.meaning: TechnoX instrument definition labels this controller as FX2 send.

sysex_parameter_mapping.note: Controller labels do not establish which Part SysEx byte, if any, they modify. No offset bindings are asserted.
